title: A photorealistic cinematic vertical full
prompt:
A photorealistic cinematic vertical full-body fashion portrait of a clearly adult young woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, seated elegantly on a minimalist chrome-framed transparent acrylic chair inside a softly decorated modern studio or boutique interior. Her specific ethnicity or race should remain unspecified because it cannot be reliably determined from appearance alone. She has fair, smooth skin with warm-neutral undertones and realistic natural texture. Her face is petite and softly oval with a gently tapered jawline, delicate facial proportions, neatly shaped dark eyebrows, large almond-shaped dark-brown eyes looking directly toward the camera, a small refined nose, and naturally full rosy-red lips. Her expression is warm, composed, and subtly playful, with a gentle closed-mouth smile.

She has extremely long, thick, softly wavy dark-brown to near-black hair, parted near the center and cascading over one shoulder to below her waist, with natural volume around the crown and face. She wears a fitted light taupe-beige mini dress with very thin spaghetti straps, a straight neckline, close-fitting ruched fabric along the torso and skirt, and a short hemline ending high on the thighs. Do not add any jacket, cardigan, stockings, or extra layers. She wears a delicate silver necklace with a tiny pendant, a slim bracelet, and cream-colored open-toe ankle-strap high-heeled sandals with block heels. Her fingernails and toenails are painted deep burgundy red.

Her posture is graceful and feminine: she sits slightly angled toward the camera with her torso upright, one hand resting lightly on her upper thigh while the other reaches down to hold the edge of the chair. Her legs are crossed elegantly at the knees and extended diagonally toward the foreground, emphasizing the depth of the composition.

The room has warm ivory walls, a beige low cabinet behind her, a tall leafy indoor plant in a narrow glass vase, framed artwork, a small cream table lamp, tiny wall photographs, and a round side table covered with an ivory crochet lace cloth holding a clear vase of pale peach roses. Soft ceiling spotlights create warm pools of light on the wall. Photograph with a natural 50mm lens perspective, eye-level framing, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, subtle cinematic softness, realistic skin rendering, gentle warm beige color grading, muted highlights, soft shadows, and refined editorial fashion photography aesthetics. 9:16
